LESSON: WEAVING CRAFT

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PAPER
Topic 5.1: Weaving CRAFT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Weaving CRAFT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you use the b) Weave using papers for fun. of paper strips woven materials for?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate own and others work • Learners work in pairs, small groups as they practice weaving. • Learners observe safety as they work in groups. • Learners display their work and gallery walk

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WEAVING CRAFT
This lesson teaches Weaving CRAFT for PP1 PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Appreciate own and others work • Learners work in pairs, small groups as they practice weaving. • Learners observe safety as they work in groups. • Learners display their work and gallery walk
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Weaving CRAFT using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Weaving CRAFT above.
2. Explain Weaving CRAFT to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Weaving CRAFT.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weaving CRAFT with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Weaving CRAFT important for a PP1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you use the b) Weave using papers for fun. of paper strips woven materials for?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Appreciate own and others work • Learners work in pairs, small groups as they practice weaving. • Learners observe safety as they work in groups. • Learners display their work and gallery walk

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
